newsitem.title: USA: Ryder selling consumer truck rental business.
newsitem.headline: Ryder selling consumer truck rental business.

text.p: Ryder System Inc said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its consumer truck rental business for about $575 million in cash to a consortium of investors led by Questor Partners Fund LP.
The company said that neither its commercial truck-rental business nor its Canadian consumer truck-rental business are part of the deal.
Ryder Chairman, President and Chief Executive M. Anthony Burns said in a statement that the company may use the money to pay down debt, to invest, or to buy back Ryder stock.
